001: Good morning, I wanted to open a checking account, please.
Of course, may I see your ID and proof of address?
Yes, here is my passport and the electricity bill.
Perfect, everything is in order. Would you also like a debit card?
Yes, please, and I wanted to know if the account has any fees.
No, this account is free if you keep a minimum balance of three hundred euros.
002: Hello, I need to make a transfer to another bank.
Alright, can you tell me the amount and the recipient's account number?
It's two hundred fifty euros, and here is the account number.
Very well, do you want the transfer to be immediate or standard?
I prefer it to be immediate, please.
Understood, it will be done in a few seconds. Do you need anything else?
003: I've lost my credit card and I'm very worried.
Don't worry, we'll block it right away. When did you last see it?
I used it this morning at an ATM and I think I left it there.
It's already blocked. We'll issue you a new one within a few business days.
And can I keep using the app to pay in the meantime?
Yes, you can use your phone to pay without any problem.
004: I wanted to take out travel insurance for next month.
Very well, can you tell me the destination and the duration of the trip?
I'm going to Japan for two weeks.
We have several options. Are you interested in full coverage with medical assistance?
Yes, I prefer the one with the best health coverage.
Then I recommend the premium policy, which includes cancellation and baggage.
005: I need to exchange these dollars into euros, please.
Of course, may I see your passport, please? It's required for the transaction.
Here it is. What is today's exchange rate?
It's at zero point ninety-two. How many dollars do you want to exchange?
Perfect, that's four hundred sixty euros. Here is your money and the receipt.
006: Hello, I'm here to pick up a new card that I requested last week.
Let me verify with your ID, please. Can I have your ID card?
Yes, here it is. Is it ready yet?
One moment, please... Yes, here it is. Would you like me to explain how to activate it?
Yes, please, I'm not really sure how it works.
It's very simple: you have to call the number on the sticker.
007: I haven't been able to access online banking for several days.
I see, what message do you get when you try to log in?
It says the password is incorrect, but I'm sure I'm typing it correctly.
It could be a security issue. We'll reset it for you right now.
And will I have to set something up again on my phone?
Yes, we'll send you a code by text message so you can activate the new password.
008: I wanted to set up automatic payments for my homeowners' association fees from my account.
Alright, did you bring the bank document from the service provider?
Yes, here is the form filled out and signed.
Perfect, can you confirm the account number where you want to set it up?
It's the one at the bottom of the form.
Very well, the automatic payment will be active within a few days.
009: I'd like to apply for a personal loan to renovate the kitchen.
Very well, how much do you need and over how many years would you like to pay it back?
I need eight thousand euros and I'd like to pay it back over five years.
Alright, with your paycheck and your credit history, there won't be a problem. I'll prepare the application.
How long will it take to get an answer?
Usually, between two and three business days.
010: Good morning, I wanted to close my account because I'm moving to another country.
Understood, can you tell me the account number and confirm that you have no pending bills?
Yes, this is the number, and I don't have any pending bills.
Perfect, would you like the remaining balance to be transferred to another account?
Yes, please, to my account at the bank in Germany.
Alright, you'll receive the closing confirmation within a few days.
